description.value:
Spending at least a minute watching or interacting with a creature outside combat lets you gauge how it stacks up against you. Choose two of the traits below; for each, the GM tells you whether the creature is your equal, better, or worse than you.

  • Strength score
  • Dexterity score
  • Constitution score
  • Armor Class
  • Current hit points
  • Total class levels (if any)
  • Fighter class levels (if any)
